output.text: {"notes":["The requested channels are terminal readouts at absolute time t=2.0 s in the world frame; position is in m, swing angle in rad, angular velocity in rad/s, and boundary_crossed is boolean.","The world frame is right-handed with x forward, y left, and z up; positive swing angle displaces the load toward +x.","A scheduled support intervention runs on [0.522, 0.722) s: acceleration is +0.22285308694700992 m/s² for 0.1 s, then the same magnitude in the negative direction for 0.1 s, after which the support is stationary.","boundary_crossed denotes whether the load center of mass crosses x=0.1 m after the 0.2 s observation cutoff, using 0.005 m hysteresis."]}
